teacherNotes: First review pair after L060. R001 introduces no new characters and must be paired with R002 to cover L001-L030.

approvedSentences.text: 一二三，大家一起看鳥飛
approvedSentences.spokenText: 一二三大家一起看鳥飛
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, or logos. Outdoor schoolyard or park scene. A small group of children are happily looking up together as several little birds fly across the sky. The children should clearly act together, with shared gaze and pointing gestures, so the scene reads as everyone watching birds fly. Keep the image calm, bright, and child-friendly.

approvedSentences.text: 一個小孩在門前看小鳥
approvedSentences.spokenText: 一個小孩在門前看小鳥
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, or logos. Front door of a cozy home. One small child stands in front of the door, quietly watching a little bird near the doorway, either perched on a low branch or hopping on the ground. The door-front setting and the child's focused attention on the bird must be visually clear.

approvedSentences.text: 女孩和男孩去山下看水
approvedSentences.spokenText: 女孩和男孩去山下看水
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, arrows, or logos. A girl and a boy walk together on a safe path toward the bottom of a mountain. At the foot of the mountain there is clear water, such as a stream or small lake, and both children are looking at it. The mountain, the lower position, the walking action, and the water should all be clear.

Warm watercolor children picture-book style for a Taiwan Traditional Chinese character-recognition app. No visible text, letters, numbers, labels, zhuyin, signage, UI, watermark, speech bubbles, or logos. Close, gentle comparison scene at a family table. An adult hand and a small child's hand are placed side by side, with the adult fingers visibly much larger. The hands should be friendly and natural, not scary, with the comparison of finger size immediately clear.
